Title: Form Recognizer is now generally available

Body.Content:
Announcing the general availability release of Form Recognizer. Accelerate your business processes by automating information extraction.

You can now extract text, tables, and key value pairs quickly and accurately from documents. With just a few samples, Form Recognizer tailors its understanding to your documents, both on-premises and in the cloud. It supports multi-page documents (Images, PDFs and Tiff files) and extract a structured representation output of the document and its contents.

Please visit the Form Recognizer pricing page for updated pricing taking effect August 1st, 2020.

Learn more
